review_notes: The capability map in the AI Systems Laboratory. Moved from About's former Areas of Exploration, unchanged: every capability-to-project link was checked against that project's source.
Each `example` and each topic's `projects` entry states something confirmed in that project's source.

The six topics after the original six were each checked against their projects' source: Machine Learning, OCR and Document Intelligence, AI Models and Platforms, Data and Database Systems, Frontend Engineering, Analytics and Forecasting.

capabilities.label: RAG and Retrieval Systems
capabilities.description: Finding the right source text first, so a result rests on real material.

projects.note: TF-IDF retrieval over a local knowledge base.
Retrieval over chunks of uploaded PDFs.
A knowledge base ranked by keyword matches.

capabilities.label: Generative AI and LLM Applications
capabilities.description: Using language models where they help, inside a system that keeps them on track.

projects.note: Gemini generates questions and evaluates answers.
Gemini personalizes a shortlist it cannot change.
Gemini writes answers, flashcards and quizzes.

capabilities.label: NLP
capabilities.description: Turning human language into signals and scores that software can act on.

projects.note: Signal analysis of conversations.
Text processing for retrieval over study material.

capabilities.label: Recommendation Engines
capabilities.description: Ranking real items against a profile, in a way that can be explained.

projects.note: Hybrid TF-IDF and weighted ranking of catalogue gifts.

capabilities.label: Backend and API Engineering
capabilities.description: The services, data and contracts that make everything else dependable.

projects.note: FastAPI routers with JWT authentication.
A REST API over the analysis core.
A REST API over the recommender.
FastAPI for accounts, documents and chat.
A thin FastAPI layer with no business logic.

capabilities.label: Intelligent Data Applications
capabilities.description: Turning everyday records into something a person can understand and use.

projects.note: Rule-based congestion insights from queue state.
Reports, budgets and trends from personal records.

capabilities.label: Machine Learning
capabilities.description: Learning from data. Here it vectorizes text and scores candidates; none of these projects trains a predictive model.

projects.note: Scikit-learn TF-IDF vectors for the knowledge-base search.
Scikit-learn TF-IDF vectors for retrieval over PDF chunks.
Scikit-learn similarity plus engineered match scores for each gift.

capabilities.label: OCR and Document Intelligence
capabilities.description: Reading the text inside images and documents, so it can be analysed.

projects.note: Reads chat screenshots with Tesseract OCR.
Extracts PDF text page by page with PyMuPDF, then chunks it.

capabilities.label: AI Models and Platforms
capabilities.description: The model APIs behind the generative features, and calling them reliably. All three use Google's Gemini API.

projects.note: Gemini through the GenAI SDK, with three attempts per request.
Gemini with a fallback model, and Groq for streamed chat.
Gemini with a response schema it must follow.

capabilities.label: Data and Database Systems
capabilities.description: Where the data lives, and how it is queried.

projects.note: SQLite with hand-written SQL for documents, chunks and study material.
SQLite for saved analyses and history.
SQLite for recommendation history.
SQLAlchemy over SQLite locally; its Docker setup runs PostgreSQL.

capabilities.label: Frontend Engineering
capabilities.description: The interfaces people actually use, from React apps to Python dashboards.

projects.note: A Next.js and React study workspace.
A React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS finance app.
A React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS interview platform.
React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS queue screens.
A Streamlit interface for the analysis.
A Streamlit interface for recommendations.

capabilities.label: Analytics and Forecasting
capabilities.description: Turning records into figures, trends and stated estimates.

projects.note: Reports, a least-squares spending trend and a next-month estimate from a three-month average.
Wait and service times, priority share and no-shows from queue tokens.
Score history and topic averages across interviews.
